question: Which company will hold the #1 rank on the LMArena Text Arena leaderboard on September 17, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: incumbent-lab retention of the #1 slot on the Chatbot Arena/LMArena Text Overall board, 2023-2026, which has changed hands roughly 2-3 times in ~16 months (OpenAI o3 -> Google gemini-3-pro late 2025 -> Anthropic since Jan 2026), implying ~5% displacement risk per 10-day window and ~0.90 incumbent retention as the prior. Adjusting on specifics: Anthropic holds ranks #1 through #4 simultaneously (1507/1505/1504/1502), so a challenger must clear 1507 AND every Claude variant, not merely enter the top cluster; nearest non-Anthropic is 8 points back with overlapping CIs. Downward pressure comes from two unlisted frontier releases (GPT-6 Astra, 09-03; Muse Spark 1.3, 09-02) that could hit Text Arena inside the 10.2 remaining days; Astra's Code-Arena WebDev #1 shows real strength, but the liquid debut-score ladder puts only ~18% on it debuting above 1510, and it must also actually list before 09-17. A $2.5M Polymarket on the same instrument prices Anthropic 88% for a window 13 days LONGER than this one, so the shorter horizon should sit above that. The low-liquidity Manifold top-3 market at 51% is a stricter and much noisier contract (an entrant at 1505 breaks top-3 without taking #1). I land modestly above the Polymarket number and split residual mass toward OpenAI, the only challenger with an imminent, demonstrably frontier unlisted model.

It is real evidence of strength in a sibling arena run by the same operator, but Artificial Analysis puts Astra below Fable 5.1 on intelligence and OpenAI has a long record of underperforming on Text Arena specifically. The debut-score ladder already prices this transfer at ~19%, so I defer to it rather than re-litigating. Net: I did not average the runs. I rebuilt the challenger mass from two matched-instrument markets and landed at Anthropic 0.895 - above the Sep-30 book's 88c because our window is shorter, above Runs 2 and 3 because their Meta mass does not survive contact with a $308k contract at half a cent.
